import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static long qpow(long x, long n) {
        long ans = 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) ans = ans * x % MOD;
            x = x * x % MOD;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int P = sc.nextInt();
        int K = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        if (K == 0) {
            System.out.println(qpow(P, P - 1));
            return;
        }

        if (K == 1) {
            System.out.println(qpow(P, P));
            return;
        }

        boolean[] visited = new boolean[P];
        int p = 1;
        int cnt = 0;
        while (!visited[p]) {
            cnt++;
            visited[p] = true;
            p = (int)((long)K * p % P);
        }

        System.out.println(qpow(P, P / cnt));
    }
}
